summary: Full-stack verification of the new Lab v3 Stage-1 'Accounts' unified 3-question transfer flow for Test 519 LLC. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass covering (a) POST /reviewv2/account-transfer-propose happy-path returns valid AI proposal JSON (ok, account_code, account_name, account_type, is_new, reason, confidence, flag_for_cpa) and rejects 400 when purpose_text is empty; (b) POST /reviewv2/account-transfer-book resolves/creates the contact from new_contact_name, correctly ignores the AI-echoed placeholder account_id='existing-uuid-or-null' and falls through to account_code lookup (verified account['id'] matched the code lookup, not the poisoned uuid), stamps outside account + posts txn_ids with needs_review=false; (c) lab-v3-queue silently skips any reason='account_personal_use' rows; (d) stage1_accounts items carry needs_transfer_flow=true, linked_contact_id, linked_contact_name (both null for Test 519's two unresolved accounts today: outside_chk_7984 / affiliate_transfer_reason with 3 txns and payment_app_paypal / unknown_account with 1 txn). Frontend (Playwright, pro@axiom.ai → Test 519 LLC → /accounting/review): sidebar Stage-1 label now reads 'Accounts · 2 questions' (old 'Your accounts' string absent). Stage1AccountsCard [data-testid=reviewv2-card-stage-1-accounts] renders the three labeled sections, contact picker [reviewv2-stage1-contact-picker] is searchable, typing a new name shows [reviewv2-stage1-contact-picker-create] '+ Add "X" as a new contact', purpose textarea [reviewv2-stage1-purpose] gates the AI button [reviewv2-stage1-ai-propose] which is disabled until both are set, clicking it produces a proposal card [reviewv2-stage1-proposal] in ~3s ('Create 2200 · Due to Larry PWTest (liability) · Owner said this was a loan repayment to Larry.') and enables [reviewv2-stage1-confirm] labeled 'Create & Post 2'. Old business/personal/another_business button strip is gone. Stage 2 sidebar entry (Confirm patterns) still present — did not regress. Book endpoint NOT clicked from the UI to avoid corrupting demo data; the equivalent write path is fully verified in test_book_endpoint_smoke_with_ai_placeholder_account_id (backend).
critical_code_review_comments: reviewv2.py account_transfer_book (line ~1915): account_id AI-placeholder filter correctly excludes '', 'null', 'None', 'existing-*' — good. Consider also filtering by uuid regex for robustness, since a stray non-uuid string could still hit the accounts collection query (won't match anything, so harmless but wasteful). Not blocking.

reviewv2.py account_transfer_book: response returns `contact`, `account`, `affected`, `rule_saved` but not `card_key` — the frontend refetch hook uses answer_transfer_booked; this pairing works but including card_key in the response would help debugging.

ReviewV2Lab.jsx Stage1AccountsCard direction hardcoded to 'mixed' (line ~1949): comment says samples don't carry sign, but item.samples does encode the sign via money-in/money-out shape earlier — could be tightened for a slightly better AI prompt.
seed_data_creation: None. Backend test creates a single TEST_XferBook_<hex> contact then rolls back via /reviewv2/lab-v3-undo on the affected txn. The UI walkthrough did NOT click 'Create & Post 2' to keep Test 519 demo state intact — only backend regression exercised the write path.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Queue shape for Test 519 LLC currently: stage1_accounts=2 (outside_chk_7984/affiliate_transfer_reason 3 txns $420 total; payment_app_paypal/unknown_account 1 txn), stage2_patterns / stage3_oneoffs also populated. Both stage1 cards carry needs_transfer_flow=true with null linked_contact_id (no accounts have been linked to a contact yet). To exercise the book endpoint E2E from the UI without corrupting demo data, use the /reviewv2/lab-v3-undo endpoint with the txn_ids returned by the queue. Backend test file is at /app/backend/tests/test_reviewv2_stage1_accounts.py — run with `pytest -o addopts=""` (or `-p no:xdist`) since pytest.ini sets loadscope. Login response payload uses key 'token' not 'access_token' — noted in file. Queue keys are stage1_accounts / stage2_patterns / stage3_oneoffs (not stage1/2/3).
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All 12 spec items verified.
